items.title: Quanta Services Stock Rises on Upgrade. Here’s Why Labor Is the Key.
items.summary: A growing shortage of skilled workers needed to build data centers will likely accelerate  Quanta Services  ’ earnings at a faster rate than Wall Street expects, Bernstein analysts wrote Thursday.  Bernstein upgraded Quanta to Outperform from Market Perform and raised its price target for the stock to $775 from $748, implying a 22% upside from its closing price of $634.90 on Wednesday.  Labor constraints will emerge for the broader data-center buildout, to which Quanta has “invested aggressively to capture this opportunity,” the analysts wrote.

items.title: How a Roth IRA Can Keep Thousands More of Your DJIA Dividend Income Compounding
items.summary: Holding blue-chip Dow dividend payers in a taxable account quietly hands the IRS a cut of every reinvested dollar, year after year, and the compounding cost over two decades is far steeper than most investors expect.
